notes: Template applied per function of the batch: normal, abnormal and one add per validation.

value: The author starts the action from the current screen.
The system validates the request and performs the work.
The system shows the result and the next available actions.
A validation fails: the system highlights the field and keeps every entered value except secrets.
The model provider times out: the system releases the reserved credits, keeps the previous content and offers a retry.

value.statement: The target of the action must be selected before it can run.
The action is allowed only for the author who owns the project.
